story.title: AI has access to a vastly larger working memory than the human brain

draft:
I've been thinking a lot about the implications of AI having a vastly larger working memory than the human brain. 
This changes the game for complex problem solving. 
Key benefits include:
* Faster processing of large datasets
* Ability to recognize patterns on a massive scale
What does this mean for human-AI collaboration?
#AI #MachineLearning #WorkingMemory
